suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Enforce a strict mismatch failure when a handoff marks followedProcedure=true but omits required interactiveChecks for features with manual/UI verification requirements.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-foundation-scrutiny reviewer observed the same mismatch in handoff metadata (required interactive checks absent while followedProcedure remained true).
